A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new discriminative correlation filter with channel and spatial reliability (DCF-CSR).
we propose a novel discriminative correlation filter that is able to exploit the correlation information between channels and across the spatial locations of a given channel.
DCF-CSR is a correlation filter based tracker which uses the spatial and channel reliability information to improve the performance of the tracker.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the discriminative filter can be augmented with a spatial reliability term, which is computed from the target appearance model.
the correlation filter is a linear filter, and that its coefficients can be computed in closed form.
the DCF- CSR tracker outperforms all the state-of-the-art trackers on a large benchmark dataset.
